message.content:
The most widely referenced Pantone code for a classic “sky blue” is **Pantone 14‑4318 TPG** (Pantone “Sky Blue”).  

> **Pantone 14‑4318 TPG – Sky Blue**  
> - *Hex:* #87CEEB (approximate)  
> - *RGB:* 135, 206, 235  

Pantone offers many variations of sky‑blue tones (e.g., 14‑4318, 14‑4319, 15‑4320, etc.), so if you need a specific shade or a different intensity, let me know and I can help narrow it down!
